gates.text: Use this route when no narrower playbook fits, or for a large/cross-cutting auditable run. Start with a checklist to read relevant native principles, then Frame / Design / Loop / Trail / Verify. BEFORE ANY CODE, write a named workflow with a falsifiable done predicate, quantified units/effort/scope, grounded blockers and highest-risk unknown, constraints, and an explicit rigor level with its gates/artifacts and rationale. Bias rigor high for one-way doors and blast radius; present framing/tradeoffs and take one framing checkpoint before committing to a multi-hour run. Proceed with authorized reversible work, preserving every explicit user gate.

Write the designed phase list before execution. Decompose into atomic independently deliverable units, riskiest unknown first, with scaffold and a verification harness BEFORE features. Capture the pre-change baseline so checks compare old versus new. One-way-door design choices run native architect/arena; skip redundant design contests for settled mechanical work, not required independent gates.

Choose parallel seams and disjoint outputs without over-fan-out. Resolve every worker and independent judge through pstack_route and native sessions_spawn with emitted arguments; pair delegated work with an actual judge and inspect artifacts. If a required delegate, design comparison or judge cannot run, mark that gate BLOCKED, never silently replace it with sequential parent work. Preserve existing owners and authorized resource limits; do not create branches/worktrees without authority.

Execute the written phases under a per-unit hypothesis → smallest change → measure on the real artifact → keep/revert loop. Verify each unit before the next, not only at the end. Suspect the observation method when a pass is too easy. If a worker games a gate, reset the affected attempt and harden its contract; fix a wrong gate as its own change rather than routing around it. Verdicts are VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED or INCONCLUSIVE; inconclusive is NOT a pass and negative results stay visible.

Compose native show-me-your-work throughout execution, one row as each step reaches its checkpoint, including pivots/reverts/blockers. That route owns the canonical trail, run boundaries, transcript audit, mandatory different-family review and Attention section; do not invent a weaker parallel log. Keep the trail local unless committing is authorized and warranted for review. No standing program, scheduler or implicit publication.

Verify the whole real product against the original predicate, not only the harness, and encode recurring corrections as structural gates within authority. Return the named playbook/phase list, rigor level/why, decision-trail path, per-predicate VERIFIED/NOT VERIFIED/INCONCLUSIVE evidence, open work and blocked gates, plus show-me-your-work’s Attention output.

Write each row right after the commit or checkpoint it records, before the next unit starts; never batch rows at the end. A row written late says so and gives the commit and the time of the checkpoint it records.
